toefl_min.value: The Faculty of SCIENCE (which runs most STEM PhDs) asks for no TOEFL certificate: English is checked in an interview with your principal supervisor.
toefl_min.quote: Applicants whose principal language is not English must demonstrate that their English language skills are at a level corresponding to the requirements. | This is done by an interview with the principal supervisor.

ielts_min.value: The Faculty of SCIENCE asks for no IELTS certificate: English is checked in an interview with your principal supervisor.
ielts_min.quote: Applicants whose principal language is not English must demonstrate that their English language skills are at a level corresponding to the requirements. | This is done by an interview with the principal supervisor.

english_waiver.value: No English test is needed for the Faculty of SCIENCE; non-native speakers show their English in an interview with the principal supervisor. The Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences differs (see biomed).
english_waiver.quote: Applicants whose principal language is not English must demonstrate that their English language skills are at a level corresponding to the requirements. | This is done by an interview with the principal supervisor.

notes: Rules are from the Faculty of SCIENCE PhD School; the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences sets its own English rules (biomed record). No application fee, fee waiver or GRE page was found: applications are made for advertised positions and go through the department. From 1 Jan 2027 UCPH charges a PhD tuition fee that your funding must cover.
